model_options.current: Current BC/PPO already use a neural network: geometry in, five shot parameters out. It does not explicitly predict physics.
model_options.evaluation: Fit only TRAIN/development trajectories; split by bucket layout and shot family. Validate uncertainty and native captures on newly frozen future holdouts. Do not count predictions as simulator successes.
model_options.feasibility: Keep exact IK/clearance checks separate. A dynamics model cannot make a rejected arm configuration feasible.
model_options.recommendation: Try a small uncertainty-aware ensemble forward model before a video WAM: geometry plus shot settings predicts rebound velocity, first-flight aperture error and capture/retention.

sources.title: MBPO: short model rollouts and model bias

model_options.wam: A world-action model predicts future observations/states and actions jointly. Rich visual interaction data would be needed for a useful task-specific comparison; pretrained video priors are not verified bounce physics.

optimization_history.caveat: PPO clipping compares each update with its own behavior policy, not with the original BC policy. These diagnostics do not establish causality.
optimization_history.metric_definition: KL and likelihood-ratio fractions compare each saved behavior model with its final model after six epochs on that update buffer. Ratio outside[0.8,1.2] is not an invalid physical action.

jointly_admitted.caveat: Conditional descriptive cohort; rejected requests remain in the primary50 denominator.
